phantaskippy wrote:

You'll still be more vulnerable to the environment, and any other villian targets that you didn't hit.

I prefer old Mainstay as well. I guess the new one could be useful if you really need to break through DR, but this seems like a rare situation. It seems like the new Sentinels would be good against villains who deal a lot of their damage personally. Medico trades out general-purpose healing for Sentinels healing and a card draw abilty. New Writhe seems more situational. He's really good against certain villains, but against others he's mostly useless where old Writhe is still useful.

This looks like a really well-designed promo to me. It doesn't seem way more or less powerful than the original, just different. There are some situations where I'd prefer the new Sentinels, and others where I'd prefer the old versions.
